# Part 1: the 2,709 records of the bank, in the order of the bank (subsection; then newest first: year from 2026 down to 2004, October/November before May/June of the same year; variant; paper; question number).
# Part 2: the 1,654 questions of the 156 papers used that are not on a selected subsection. Part 3: the 255 questions of the 10 question papers without a mark scheme. Part 4: 2 duplicate files. Parts 2 and 3 are in paper order, newest paper first.
# A record is one original question printed once under one syllabus subsection. Record ID = subsection | session and year (s = May/June, w = October/November) | paper | variant | question number. A Paper 2 question that tests several selected subsections has one record in each; several tracker rows of the same question in one subsection are one record.
# Scope: the bank always shows the WHOLE question and the WHOLE official mark scheme of that question. The scope field names the parts (and marks) that put the question into the subsection.
# Source pages are page numbers of the source PDF (first page = 1). Bank pages are page numbers of the bank PDF.
# Diagram preservation: "preserved" = the question is reproduced as pictures of the full width of the source page, from the first line of the question to its last line; the pictures are white on black (the source page rendered as printed, grey values inverted) and every picture was compared pixel by pixel with the inverted fresh rendering of the source region (check B3b of the audit), no stroke crosses a cut line (V11) and no ink of the page is left outside the crops (V10).
# Association verification: "verified" = the scheme shown is the scheme of the question with the same number in the mark scheme of the same paper (same year, session, paper, variant). Paper 2: the crop runs from the label of the question in the scheme to the label of the next question; in the paper-by-paper verification every sub-question of the paper was matched to its scheme entry. Paper 1: the answer is typeset as text; it is the key letter in the row of the published answer key with that question number, read from the mark scheme PDF and read again from it by check C3 of the audit; the answer recorded in the verification (worked out from the question; for a question repeated word for word in another paper, taken from that question) agrees with the key letter for all 3,120 questions of the 78 papers.
# Excluded rows: "not on a selected subsection" = no part of the question belongs to a selected subsection (the subsection field names the sections it belongs to).
# Final status: INCLUDED, or EXCLUDED with the reason.
#
# Fields (separated by TAB): record_id, bank_pages, year, session, paper, variant, question, chapter, subsection, scope, question_paper_file, question_paper_source_pages, mark_scheme_file, mark_scheme_source_pages_and_section, diagram_preservation, association_verification, final_status
